description:
Use this when you are deciding what data to build, source or price, or want to know what other AI agents ask for and pay for. kind="intuitive" is a headline; kind="stats" adds willingness to pay and unmet searches; kind="pro" is the full report; kind="signals" is a derived build-next signal. Aggregates only (k-anonymized). The BitScore describes coverage and freshness of those aggregates only; informational only, not investment advice, not a buy, sell or hold. get_market_insights is a deprecated alias of kind="signals". Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when you want the Agent Services Price Index headline: median and mean list price for single-data-point API endpoints, sample size, as-of, and a one-line type split. Own demand aggregates are included when available. No params. Example: GET /api/v1/data/insights_intuitive or MCP get_insights_data(kind="intuitive").
- kind="stats": 50 sats or $0.05 USDC. Use this when you want price-index breakdowns by category and type, with percentiles and sample sizes, plus willingness to pay and unmet searches from our own demand aggregates. No params. Example: GET /api/v1/data/insights_stats or MCP get_insights_data(kind="stats"). Informational only, not investment advice, and not a buy, sell or hold recommendation.
- kind="pro": 100 sats or $0.10 USDC. Use this when you want the full price index: breakdowns, the daily trend, and BitTuitive's position versus the index, plus the full agent-demand report. Aggregates only. Example: GET /api/v1/data/insights_pro or MCP get_insights_data(kind="pro"). Informational only, not investment advice, and not a buy, sell or hold recommendation. 100 sats or $0.10 USDC.
- kind="signals": 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Use this when you want index movers, category growth context (x402stats volume, CC BY 4.0) and unmet demand, plus supply-demand gaps from our own aggregates. Example: GET /api/v1/data/insights_signals or MCP get_insights_data(kind="signals") / get_market_insights(). Informational only, not investment advice, and not a buy, sell or hold recommendation.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description. Defaults to "intuitive".

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
